lines.inspiration.struck: An idea arrives. You let it wait a second. You don't chase ideas. They come to you, and this one did, and you exhale.
lines.inspiration.expired: It left. You let it. You lean on something and watch it go like it was your call.
lines.scavenge.found: You pick up {item} without looking at it, like you'd left it there on purpose.
lines.scavenge.nothing: Nothing. You weren't really looking. You make sure your posture says so.
lines.item.used: You finish the {item} and flick what's left of it somewhere without checking where. It lands in a puddle. Perfect. Nobody saw.
lines.making.started: You start like it's no big deal. It's a very big deal. Your hands know; your face doesn't.
lines.piece.artist.solid: Done: {work}. You glance at it once, the way you'd glance at a car you own.
lines.piece.artist.rough: Done: {work}. It's off. You decide it's off on purpose, and stand next to it like that's true.
lines.location.return: {place}. You lean on something like coming back was the plan.
lines.perception.misfire: You play it off. You're at {place}. You meant to be at {place}. Nobody believes you, including you.
lines.fight.started: You square up on {name}, sort of. You're leaning on something while you do it.
lines.fight.cracked.you: You swing. It's uncool. You know it's uncool while it's happening, which is the uncoolest part.
lines.fight.landed.you: It lands. You act like it didn't. That's the move.
lines.fight.landed.them: It lands on you. You go down slow, like you meant to. You didn't.
lines.fight.ontop.you: You're on top of {name}. You'd rather not be. It looks like effort.
lines.fight.ontop.them: {name}'s on top. You look bored about it. It's the only thing you've got.
lines.fight.walked: You walk. Slowly. Like you'd been planning to leave anyway. You had not.
lines.fight.barred: 86'd from {place}. Fine. It was getting crowded. You light one outside and say that to nobody.
